github.description: 🚀 Solaris Media Production Suite is a modular toolkit for audiovisual production, live streaming, and digital content creation. It combines scripts, automation, configurations, and production resources to optimize workflows, simplify operations, and support scalable, multi-platform content delivery. 🎥📡⚙️

lastCommit.message:
Add Multiplatform and Video publishers

Introduces two new local publishing modules: a Multiplatform Markdown/MDX publisher with platform adapters, SHA-256 review, local server, and security controls, and a Video Publisher for long/short videos with serial publishing limits and official API adapters. This change also adds configs, launchers, docs, tests, and README updates for both suites.
